sections.title: Computer Vision Applications for Denver Organizations
sections.description: Production-grade CV solutions for Denver's leading industries.

blocks.heading: Aerospace Component Inspection (Space Corridor)
paragraphs: For Lockheed Martin Space (Littleton), United Launch Alliance (Centennial), and the Space Corridor manufacturing supply chain:

Precision component inspection: CV for the precision machined components in Space Corridor manufacturing — detecting dimensional defects, surface irregularities, and material inconsistencies in the high-tolerance components used in satellite systems, launch vehicles, and space exploration hardware.

Composite structural inspection: Optical and thermographic inspection of carbon fiber composite structures for the Space Corridor's advanced composite manufacturing — detecting void content, delamination, and fiber orientation defects in space vehicle structures.
Electronic assembly inspection: CV for PCB and electronic assembly quality inspection for the defense electronics manufacturers in Denver's South Metro corridor.
Commercial, non-classified applications only. Self-hosted for data sovereignty.
Cost: $65,000–$175,000 | Timeline: 14–26 weeks | AS9100, self-hosted

blocks.heading: Solar Energy CV (Colorado's World-Class Solar)
paragraphs: Colorado has the 3rd-highest solar irradiance in the continental US — APS and SRP rival Xcel Energy's large solar portfolio:

Solar panel defect detection: CV for infrared and visible inspection of solar panel arrays — detecting cell microcracks, hotspots, delamination, and soiling from aerial drone imagery for Xcel Energy's and SRP's large utility-scale solar farms.
Solar panel performance analytics: ML combining thermal imaging CV with production data to identify underperforming panels and predict failure before production loss accumulates.

Snow load and environmental impact: CV for monitoring snow accumulation and storm damage on Colorado's solar arrays — critical for the mountain and high-altitude solar installations where snow management is a significant operations challenge.
Cost: $55,000–$150,000 | Timeline: 12–22 weeks | Utility solar context

blocks.heading: Healthcare Medical Imaging
paragraphs: For UCHealth, Centura/Intermountain Colorado, and Denver's health systems:

Altitude-calibrated medical imaging: CV for Denver's altitude-specific medical imaging challenges — pulmonary imaging for altitude-related conditions, cardiac imaging for altitude-adapted physiology, and bone density analytics calibrated to Colorado's active outdoor population.

Orthopedic and sports medicine imaging: CV for Denver's large sports medicine and orthopedic programs — fracture detection, cartilage assessment, and injury severity evaluation for the outdoor recreation injury patterns that UCHealth's trauma programs handle at high volume.
Cost: $65,000–$175,000 | Timeline: 14–26 weeks | HIPAA + Colorado AI Act

blocks.heading: Mining and Construction Safety
paragraphs: Colorado's active mining (gold, silver, coal, molybdenum) and construction sectors:

Mine site safety monitoring: CV for worker safety and equipment monitoring in Colorado's active mines — detecting unsafe proximity between workers and heavy equipment, PPE compliance, and hazardous condition identification in open pit and underground mining environments.

Construction safety for Denver's building boom: CV for PPE compliance and safety monitoring on Denver's active construction sites — complying with Colorado's OSHA equivalent requirements for construction worker safety.
Cost: $50,000–$135,000 | Timeline: 12–22 weeks | MSHA, Colorado OSHA

blocks.heading: Colorado AI Act for healthcare CV
